openings.claim: Two-step adjudication planning may expose complementary rows that independent threshold-impact ranking misses, supporting a further-evaluation decision with the same allowance.
openings.delta: Change the selection action from ranking individual rows to evaluating ordered pairs of accessible, comparative-gain-relevant flags. In a local script, score each first row by the worst-case remaining acceptance ambiguity after its best second row, branching only over supplied label possibilities; break ties by identifiers. Replan after each returned label. The carrier is a branching selection ledger plus paired gain and slice bounds.
openings.prediction: The nearest rival is G0085:R1 targeted single-row ranking. Differing observations are supported decisions, remaining gain/slice bounds, adjudications consumed and elapsed time. If complementary label effects matter, lookahead may resolve a case the rival leaves unresolved. Equal resolution, greater resource consumption without tighter relevant bounds, or failure to finish within seventy minutes defeats the proposed advantage; none is observed yet.
openings.probe: Run lookahead and the incumbent on matched copies with independently reset sixteen-row allowances and seventy-minute limits. Apply the same four preselected withheld rows; log unavailable attempts without charging adjudications. Before selecting, confirm supplied label possibilities suffice to construct branches; otherwise freeze an unresolved report. Use accessible adjudications only, logging every selection, returned label, unavailable attempt and computation time. Advance only if all remaining permissible completions meet gain >=4 and each slice loss <=2; reject only if none meets both; otherwise unresolved. Freeze both reports, then open the full-label decision key and compare support, affected slices, accounting and consumption. This is a workflow probe, not deployment evidence.
assumptions: The supplied records expose admissible label possibilities; unavailable possibilities are not invented.
Two-step branching and bound recomputation fit the supplied environment and time. A stop cap does not establish this.
Accessible flags have complementary effects; identical baseline/candidate predictions cannot change comparative gain.

assessment: A distinct selection hypothesis with uncertain computational feasibility and comparative benefit. Withholding or remaining label ambiguity may require unresolved.

lineage.reason: Preserves acceptance bounds, logging and matched comparison; changes row selection to adaptive two-step lookahead.
